html_source: 16 May 1896 photograph held in the National Library of Ireland, with writing on back identifying the "Town Hall, Dunlaoghaire" (at the bottom of Royal Marine Road) on the "first day of electrification," "William Martin Murphy" (standing with one foot on tram), "Clifton Robinson at controls," and "'Davy Stephens' (local character & newsvendor) on top deck." Source: catalogue.nli.ie.
